purpose: Full /setting snapshot taken before arming the official updater VERSKIP mode

armed_markers.reason: Official p1 getCurrentMode() requires /setting/updater/mode to exist before it tests mode6; without mode it forces MODE_PROD. mode6 selects MODE_VERSKIP=6, which execute_ufp.sh routes to 'sauu -s' -> GetVersionSkipUpdater(), skipping the same-version refusal.
armed_markers.state_before: only dat4 was present; comp absent (comp would rm -rf mode*)

rollback.restore_whole_partition: untar setting-full.tar at / (only valid if /setting was not reformatted)

warnings: MODE_VERSKIP falls into us_mkfs.sh's default branch, which runs edisx and full formatting; expect /setting and other partitions to be rewritten.
The official updater package itself is unmodified, so RSA/SHA-256 signature checks should pass.
Do not power off during the update. Battery must be charged.
